name: identity-braces
description: Every brace gets its own colour, and a few of them develop personalities.

commands.title: Identity Braces: Apply a trait preset
Identity Braces: Open the trait gallery
Identity Braces: Identify the brace at the cursor
Identity Braces: Import settings from Visual Studio

identityBraces.independentBraces.markdownDescription: **Every brace is its own person.** A closing brace gets its own colour and personality instead of inheriting its opener's. Turn off to make pairs match again.

identityBraces.round.description: Colour parentheses ( ). Turn off if the density is too much.

identityBraces.questionUnmatched.description: A brace with no partner always renders as ?. Doubles as a syntax-error hint.

enumDescriptions: One colour for every brace, following the theme.
One colour per nesting level - this is what a rainbow-brace extension does.
identityBraces.colorMode.description: How a brace's colour is decided.

identityBraces.monochromeColor.description: Colour used in monochrome mode, as #RRGGBB. Empty follows the theme.

identityBraces.palette.markdownDescription: Override the 32 identity colours, as `#RRGGBB` strings. Fewer than 32 entries fills the rest from the built-in palette; an empty array uses the built-in palette throughout.

identityBraces.scopeSpotlight.description: The pair enclosing the caret stays vivid; every other brace fades.

identityBraces.spotlightDim.description: How visible an out-of-scope brace stays, as a percentage.

identityBraces.complexityWarningDepth.description: Braces nested at least this deep are drawn sweating and unsteady. Zero switches it off.

identityBraces.indentGuides.description: A vertical guide down the inside of each multi-line pair, in that pair's colour.

identityBraces.indentGuideStrength.description: How strong the indent guides are against the background, as a percentage.

identityBraces.enableMotion.markdownDescription: **Turn this off** on battery, on a projector, or if movement in a text editor is unpleasant. Animated braces go static.

identityBraces.animationFrameRate.description: Frames per second for animated braces. The editor does not need 60.

identityBraces.colorCycleSeconds.description: Time in seconds for an animated brace to travel the whole colour wheel.

identityBraces.maxFileLength.description: Files longer than this many characters are left alone entirely.

identityBraces.decorScale.description: Multiplier for creature and costume geometry. Below 1 keeps ears closer to the line.

enumDescriptions: Clearest - nothing on it is under 5px.
One welt stripe. The legibility floor.
Two stripes. Correct at larger font sizes.
identityBraces.thighHighStyle.description: How much stripe detail the thigh highs carry.

identityBraces.tail.description: A tail curling off the bottom right of a cat brace. It is what makes the glyph read as a creature.

identityBraces.overlayNudge.markdownDescription: Moves everything drawn on a brace up or down, in `em`. Only needed if your editor font puts a brace's ink somewhere other than where we assume: negative raises the ears, positive lowers them.

enumDescriptions: Colours, glyph substitutions and drawn creatures.
Colours and glyph substitutions only. No drawn overlays.
identityBraces.renderMode.markdownDescription: How much of a brace is drawn. Drop to `text` or `plain` if overlays misbehave on your build of VS Code.

identityBraces.languages.markdownDescription: Language ids to colour. A single `*` means every language. The scanner is a C-family lexer, so it is at its best on C-family syntax.

identityBraces.traits.markdownDescription: Per-trait percentages, keyed by trait id - for example `{ "catgirl": 12, "wizard": 5 }`. Anything not listed keeps its catalogue default. Easier to edit through **Identity Braces: Open the trait gallery**.

colors.description: Brace colour used in monochrome mode when no explicit colour is set.
